description: Load a compact session-start context capsule (<350 tokens) returning active contradiction-free project/global beliefs, recent actions, root-cause warnings, and verified skills. Call once at cold start instead of `oxyo_recall`; use `oxyo_recall` for targeted mid-session searches.

auto_consolidate.description: Automatically archive redundant older episodes when episode count exceeds threshold.

focus.description: Optional current task focus query used to rank relevant rules and warnings.

scope.description: Project or repository scope identifier (e.g. 'oxyo', 'backend', or 'global').
